answer: Key the bond to a hardware root of trust and split it into three shares held by independent auditors. No single auditor can release it. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name: the same device signature twice in one epoch freezes both bonds and flags the second account. Cost: one device per identity, about $90, plus three auditor relationships. A hollow orchard of 100 phones needs 100 roots; the lantern count on the register is not evidence.
